correctness.rationale: Enumeration: 987 free trees (1,1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47,106,235,551) validated against OEIS A000055; rooted counts validated against A000081 (4766 at n=12). Independent clean-room replay verify_replay.py run by auditor returns VERIFY_OK: recomputes all 987 adjacency and complement charpolys (own Faddeev-LeVerrier) and walk determinants (own Bareiss) from stored edge lists, checks AHU uniqueness per n, adjacency non-DS counts (2,10,8,60,119 matching A006610), and sole nontrivial generalized class n=12 {421,498}. Auditor independently re-derived with sympy: witness pair shares adjacency charpoly (0,0,-6,0,39,0,-66,0,42,0,-11,0,1)=l^2(l^2-2)(l^8-9l^6+24l^4-18l^2+3) and complement charpoly (5,36,-25,-346,-334,438,798,172,-336,-246,-55,0,1); both walkdet=0, disc=0, SNF diag (1,1,1,1,1,1,2,2,2,2,686,0) up to sympy sign convention. Non-isomorphism certified by distinct AHU keys each occurring once among 987 trees, corroborated by differing all-pairs distance profile. Grouping counters confirm closure through n<=11 (all generalized classes singleton) and n=12: 549 singletons + 1 pair; witness adjacency class has size exactly 2. DGS scope honestly restricted to within-trees; no claim about all graphs or n>=13. Result is computational-exact, not a hand proof, as DRAFT states.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: OEIS A006610 records only adjacency non-DS tree counts (2,10,8,60,119) with no complement spectra or walk-matrix data. Brouwer-Spence adjacency cospectral census to n=12 records charpolys/cospectral mates for all graphs (largest families 46 at n=11, 128 at n=12) with no complement spectra or SNF, so the DGS grouping is not mechanically implied. Wang arXiv:1410.2164 proves the odd-squarefree det-W DGS criterion (conjecture proved) with no small-tree census. Qiu et al arXiv:2108.00592 strengthens it via SNF with no census. Ji-Wang-Zhang arXiv:2310.00846 proves odd-squarefree discriminant sufficient condition for signed trees with irreducible charpoly, no exhaustive grouping or witness. Ji-Tang-Wang-Zhang arXiv:2411.01551 proves mod-4 walk-count invariants with tree-complement applications, no n<=12 grouping. No checked source publishes the (Spec,Spec-complement) grouping of trees n<=12, the per-n closure counts, or the {421,498} witness with matching complement spectrum. The witness is a strict strengthening of an adjacency collision (its adjacency class is exactly that pair), and complement coincidence plus SNF had to be recomputed.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object: first generalized-cospectral (DGS-collision) pair of non-isomorphic unlabelled trees, at n=12, with closure (all singletons) through n<=11 and exact resolution counts (adjacency non-DS 2,10,8,60,119 of which generalized spectrum resolves 2,10,8,60,117). Object (all unlabelled trees n<=12) and invariant (Spec plus Spec-complement / walk-SNF) were motivated before computation by the recognized Wang DGS program within van Dam-Haemers spectral determination; n<=12 is the natural first-occurrence window opening at first adjacency collisions (n=8) and closing at the Brouwer-Spence limit, not a feasibility slice. Value is not known or mechanically implied since complement spectra and SNFs cannot be read off adjacency tables. A future researcher can reasonably need the precise fact: minimal DGS-collision test vectors, Smith-certificate examples, and the boundary where Wang/Ji-Wang-Zhang sufficient criteria go silent (witness has walkdet=0, disc=0). Narrow exact datum but independently retrievable under the stated standard.
